answer: Require every identity to keep an unbroken activity chain: at least one verified, identity-bound task each epoch, like a vine that dies if it stops growing. Miss two epochs and its accumulated weight resets to zero while its stake stays frozen for three more epochs. A dormant army is therefore worthless: 100 stockpiled fakes must each do real work every epoch, or lose everything at once. If 100 reactivations burst from one funding cluster in one epoch, re-entry stake doubles, so a tundra of idle shells only grows more expensive, and no glacier of frozen identities can wait out the rule.
